issue: The long-context benchmark counts streamed token IDs but discards their values, so equal response text cannot establish equal token sequences. Retain ordered token_ids in each stream_chat result, report token_ids_complete only when a positive completion-token count matches the collected IDs, and emit token_ids_sha256 over their compact JSON representation (null when none were received). Different chunk boundaries must not change the digest. Preserve existing text, timing and usage information; missing or partial token-ID streams must remain explicitly incomplete. Add offline streaming regression tests.
